title: Panel Discussion: Copper Outlook - Can New Supply Sources Meet Emerging Demand Drivers?
gist: Member-only listing for a 40-minute Benchmark Summit 2026 London copper panel asking whether new supply sources can meet emerging demand drivers. Panellists came from Benchmark consulting, Deepsea Minerals, the International Copper Association and Mariana Minerals; no discussion content is disclosed.

insights.claim: A 40-minute Benchmark Summit 2026 London panel was built around whether new copper supply sources can keep up with emerging demand drivers.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; James Deckelman , CEO , Deepsea Minerals; Louise A
insights.so_what: Copper supply adequacy is a headline question in battery-materials circles; it is a long-run price support narrative.
insights.quote: Can New Supply Sources Meet Emerging Demand Drivers?

insights.claim: The copper supply panel included James Deckelman, CEO of Deepsea Minerals, and Baker Tilney, co-founder and CFO of Mariana Minerals, which puts deep-sea and new-entrant miners in the 'new supply sources' conversation.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; James Deckelman , CEO , Deepsea Minerals; Louise A
insights.so_what: Watch deep-sea and startup miners as possible marginal copper supply; their presence signals investor interest.

insights.claim: Louise Assem, Vice President of Science & Regulatory Affairs at the International Copper Association, joined the copper outlook panel, with International Copper Association Europe tagged on the session, and Benchmark's Head of Consulting Shruti Kashyap moderated.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; James Deckelman , CEO , Deepsea Minerals; Louise A
insights.so_what: Having a regulatory-affairs voice on the panel suggests rules and science policy are seen as a constraint on copper supply in Europe.

source_meta.author: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; James Deckelman , CEO , Deepsea Minerals; Louise A
